title: Extraction of alpha-synuclein filaments from brain
author: Yang Yang
materials: Homogenize and release the filaments from the tissue.

steps.title: Weigh and cut tissue
steps.instruction: Cut brain tissue and weigh 0.2–0.5 g.

steps.title: Homogenize tissue in extraction buffer
steps.instruction: Homogenize the tissue in 20 vol (v/w) of extraction buffer containing 10 mM Tris‑HCl (pH 7.5), 0.8 M NaCl, 10–20 % sucrose and 1 mM EGTA.

steps.title: Add sarkosyl and incubate
steps.instruction: Adjust homogenate to 2 % (w/v) sarkosyl and incubate 60 min at 37 °C.

steps.title: Sequential centrifugation of homogenate
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the homogenate sequentially to remove debris and collect supernatant.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge 10 min at 10,000 g; keep the supernatant.
Spin the supernatant at 100,000 g (45,000 rpm) for 40–60 min.

steps.title: Dilute supernatant and spin
steps.instruction: Dilute the supernatant three‑fold with buffer 2 (50 mM Tris‑HCl pH 7.5, 0.15 M NaCl, 10 % sucrose, 0.2 % sarkosyl) and centrifuge at 45,000 rpm for 30 min.

steps.title: Resuspend pellet in buffer 3
steps.instruction: Resuspend the resulting pellet in buffer 3 at 100 µL per gram of tissue (use undiluted for Cryo‑EM; dilute 1:10 for Western blot or negative staining).

steps.title: Low‑speed spin of resuspended sample
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the resuspended sample at 3,000 g for 2 min.

steps.title: Final resuspension and spin
steps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in 500 µL per gram of extraction buffer and centrifuge again at 3,000 g for 5 min.
